purpose.zh: 练背阔肌连接上臂和躯干的力量
purpose.en: Train the lats to connect your arms to your trunk.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，从前方下拉到大腿旁
text.en: Keep your arms straight and sweep them down to your thighs

text.zh: 下拉时肩胛下沉，肋骨不外翻
text.en: Draw your shoulder blades down without flaring the ribs.

text.zh: 底部停1秒，再慢慢回到前方
text.en: Pause for one second at the bottom, then return slowly.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小幅度或换更轻的弹力带，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range or use a lighter band if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
